method: Same-agent English/Marathi close reading; exact structural and projected-formula comparison; and replay of the finite-rank lemma and the compactness/back-and-forth proof of Lindström's theorem. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Lindström's finite-rank lemma and the maximality theorem for normal abstract logics with compactness and downward Löwenheim--Skolem.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: If one natural number n makes E invariant under n-equivalence, then E is first-order definable. For each structure M, conjoin its rank-at-most-n first-order theory into D_M and disjoin the finitely many relevant D_M over the E-models.
samples.checks: Finite vocabulary, quantifier-rank bound, both directions of the model-class equality and the finite conjunction/disjunction argument are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A normal abstract logic with compactness and downward Löwenheim--Skolem is no more expressive than first-order logic. It suffices to find a finite n controlling each abstract sentence E, replacing n-equivalence by the finite back-and-forth relation in a finite relational language.
samples.checks: OLFOL-049 restores the normality hypothesis that the proof uses; the expressive-comparison direction and finite relational restriction remain exact.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Assuming no such n, choose M_n and N_n with I_n but opposite E-values. Use disjoint isomorphic copies to form the M and N unions, build one coding structure A containing their sequence extensions and an ordered natural-number sort, and let D encode all indexed back-and-forth relations. Compactness applied to D plus a new constant above every standard element yields A-star with a non-standard n-star. The relations at n-star minus k give a genuine partial isomorphism between M_{n-star} and N_{n-star}, contradicting the preceding theorem.
samples.checks: The indexed domains, four displayed set-builders, J/I clauses, abstract satisfaction polarities, non-standard subtraction, tuple lengths and final partial-isomorphism contradiction were checked formula by formula. OLFOL-050–054 repair only the necessary union, notation, satisfaction and compactness omissions.
